==Flea of the Daggerfeet==
[[Flea]] makes a den in the woods near a road that he shares with his loyal [[daggerfeet]] pack. He lost his last scruples long ago, and simply unleashes his pack of daggerfeet against caravans marked for robbery.[[File:2010.png|thumb|295px]]
